visual_review.version_key: Ours1 original factorized/context model excluded from spatial numeric axis; Ours2 anchored additive; Ours3 bounded additive; Ours4 unbounded transport; Ours5 bounded transport.
visual_review.limits: This review covers an official ICLR-width three-page proof. Final placement in the full manuscript must be inspected after integration; this receipt does not certify an unviewed later build.

resolved_editorial_issues: Caption now specifies the four registered trained comparators, avoiding the implication that persistence has an additional paired interval.
Caption word/number spacing restored; no numerical values changed.
scientific_limits: Original-validation development comparisons, not untouched-test or state-of-the-art evidence.
Ours3/4 remain incomplete as full three-seed studies in this snapshot and have no plotted numeric values.
Small context effects include zero, and coarse-coordinate context point changes are negative; context-specific benefit is not established.
All native and coarse contrasts retained but their metric coordinates are not pooled.
Mixing and bounded innovation are not isolated by these completed five modes; component-study results remain pending.
